outputFrame.policy: Slice cleaned source sheets at their native cell size, then place each cell bottom-centered into a fixed 96x96 output canvas.

sourceFramePolicy: Hand-curated clean sheets preserve native source cell sizes and use canonical role colors.

roles.label: Head / skull
roles.description: Round head control volume. This is the anchor for face/hair/helmet layers.

roles.label: Torso / hips
roles.description: Main body mass and hip/root volume. Body motion starts here, then limbs follow.

roles.label: Back arm
roles.description: Far-side arm chain. It is drawn behind torso/near limbs.

roles.label: Back hand
roles.description: Distal hand pixels attached to the rear arm in the side-scroller rig.

roles.label: Front arm
roles.description: Near-side arm chain. It is drawn in front and drives hand/equipment placement.

roles.label: Front hand
roles.description: Distal hand pixels attached to the visible front arm in the side-scroller rig.

roles.label: Front leg
roles.description: Near-side leg chain. In these source sprites it is the bright yellow limb.

roles.label: Front foot
roles.description: Distal foot pixels attached to the visible front leg in the side-scroller rig.

roles.label: Back leg
roles.description: Far-side leg chain. In these source sprites it is the red limb.

roles.label: Back foot
roles.description: Distal foot pixels attached to the rear leg in the side-scroller rig.

roles.label: Weapon
roles.description: Held weapons and combat props separated from body limbs and motion smears.

roles.label: Smear / effect
roles.description: Motion smears, trails, pale guide effects, and attack arcs separated from held weapons.

roles.label: White guide / effect
roles.description: White guide/effect pixels in some source sheets; not part of the colored limb rig.

roles.label: Ground/contact shadow
roles.description: Floor contact and dark guide pixels; not a body module.
